scientific limitations/integrity: The claim exactifies the two open-interval endpoints in the published order-three wand extremality theorem. It does not classify equality at either endpoint, other Gibbs measures, or other tree orders. Exact algebra is proved independently of finite replay checks. MSC 82B26 is verified for the same three-state hard-core wand model in the 2024 follow-up.
title: Exact radical extremality endpoints for the order-three hard-core wand model
